subject.title: Reduce tool schema token overhead (~3,500 tok/session)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for the remaining tool-schema and prompt-overhead work, and which incremental compatibility-safe path should be sequenced next?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the remaining fixes change model-facing tool defaults and prompt/schema behavior across provider, channel, cron, plugin, and context-management boundaries, so maintainer product/API intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Sequence Incrementally
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while maintainers approve narrow follow-up PRs for Tooling text, message-schema pruning, description compression, and deferred schema behavior.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonical Issues
options.body: Move each remaining subproblem to a maintainer-owned open tracker and close this only after every central gap has a canonical destination.

options.title: Defer To Tool Search Only
options.body: Decide that Tool Search and existing policy controls are the supported path, then explicitly reject further default schema-pruning work.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Sequence Incrementally
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while maintainers approve narrow follow-up PRs for Tooling text, message-schema pruning, description compression, and deferred schema behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion already contains steipete's sequencing guidance, and the decision spans product/runtime boundaries rather than one file owner.
